部分倒装:否定词与 only 前置: 否定副词或 only 状语放在句首时,助动词提前形成部分倒装,以及 so/neither 表"也/也不"。

否定词(Never, Seldom, Rarely, Hardly, Little, Not until, No sooner)开头 → 助动词提前|Only + 状语开头 → 部分倒装|So/Neither/Nor + 助动词 + 主语:表"某人也是/也不是"|Not until... did... ;No sooner had... than...|主句倒装,从句不倒装:Not until he called did I relax.
Never had the village seen such a flood.
column3: 村子从未见过这样的洪水。

部分倒装:否定词与 only 前置: Only after the audit did the truth emerge.
column3: 直到审计之后真相才浮出水面。

部分倒装:否定词与 only 前置: Seldom does she miss a deadline.
I've tried the blue route; so has my colleague.
column3: 我试过蓝线,我同事也试过。

部分倒装:否定词与 only 前置: Not until the fog lifted did the ferries restart.

# title: Never in my life ___ such a storm.
部分倒装:否定词与 only 前置: I have seen|have I seen|I saw|did I saw
column4: Never 开头,部分倒装:have I seen。

# title: Only when the results came in ___ the mistake.
部分倒装:否定词与 only 前置: we noticed|did we notice|we did notice|noticed we
column4: Only + 状语从句开头,主句倒装:did we notice。

# title: No sooner ___ the stage than the power failed.
部分倒装:否定词与 only 前置: she had stepped|had she stepped|did she step|she stepped
column4: No sooner had... than 固定倒装。

# title: Hardly ___ the door when the phone rang.
部分倒装:否定词与 only 前置: he had closed|had he closed|he closed|did he closed

# title: I don't trust the forecast, and ___ my skipper.
column4: 表"也不"用 neither + 助动词;主语 my skipper 是第三人称单数:neither does。

# title: Which sentence has the inversion in the right clause?
部分倒装:否定词与 only 前置: Not until she smiled did I sit down.|Not until she did smile I sat down.|Not until did she smile I sat down.|Not until she smiled I did sit down.
column4: Not until 时间从句不倒装,主句倒装:did I sit down。
